section.title: Kasankhidwe ka Mtundu wa Mbewu Koyenera
content: Sankhani mbewu yanu potengerana ndi nyengo ya dela lanu komanso kagwedwe ka mvula.
A kafukufuku ku unduna wa zaulimi komanso ma kampani ogulitsa mbewu ali ndi mitundu ya mbewu yosiyana siyana yomwe ingachite bwino potengera ndi dela lanu komanso zofuna za mlimi.

section.title: Komwe mungapeze mbewu Yoyenera
content: Mabungwe a kafukufuku wa zaulimi
Ma kampani ogulitsa mbewu omwe ndi wovomelezeka ndi boma
Ma bungwe omwe amagulitsa zipangizo za ulimi – awa ndi odalilika.
Mitundu ya mbewu ya chimanga ilipo ingapo – ikhoza kukhala mbewu yamakono, kapena yamakolo komanso wakasakaniza wa mbewu ya makono ndi yamakolo
Ngati mlimi wasankha mbewu ya makono, akuyenera kugula mbewu yatsopano nthawi zonse akafuna kubzyala kuti apeze kholola lochuluka.

Mbewu ya kasakaniza ikhoza kubwelezedwa kwa zaka zina ziwiri. Ngati mlimi wabzyala mbewuyi kwa chaka choyamba, akhoza kusankha mbewu ina pa kholola  kwa zaka  ziwiri zotsatizana koma chaka chinacho(chachinayi) akuyenera kudzagula mbewu ya tsopano chifukwa akabweleza ya kale yomweyo, kholola lake lidzayamba kuchepa.
Kwa mbewu ya makolo, mlimi akuyenera kusankha mbewu yoyenela pa nthawi yomwe akukolola.

Potengela kuti mlimi akuyenera kukhala ndi kholola lochuluka ndi cholinga chokhala ndi chakudya chokwanila, mlimi akulimbikitsidwa kubzyala mbewu ya chimanga ya makono. Chomwecho, wonetsetsani kuti mbewu yanu mwaiyesa kuti mutsimikizike kuti ikamera bwino.

section.title: Malo Oyenera Kulima Chimanga
content: Dothi lachonde, lamakande opepuka ndi lopanda lowe limabweretsa kholora la chimanga chochuluka
Sankhani dothi la chonde, la makande komanso lopanda lowe komwe kagwedwe ka Mvula kamapitilira ma milimitazi 500.
Chimanga chimapilira ku michere koma ngati michereyi ndi yochuluka thilani laimu ku thaka ya mmunda wanu  kuti ikhale ndi michere yofunika ndi kukolora zochuluka.
Chimanga chimavutika ndi chilara komanso malo a lowe chomwecho musabzyale chimanga pa malo a lowe  apo ayi onetsetsani kuti mwalima mizere ndi akalozera komanso kubzyala moyambilira.

Ngati ng'amba yaposera milungu inayi pa nthawi yomwe chimanga chikufura komanso ku panga ndevu ndi chiopsezo chachikulu pa kholora chomwecho kukolora komanso kusunga madzi ndi zofunikira. Izi zingatheke pobzyala pa dzenje, pophimbira, mu nthawi yomwe kuli ng'amba.
Malo otentha kuposera ma digilii 38 amasokoneza zokolora chifukwa zimasokoneza ngayaye ya chimanga. Kutentha kochepera ma digilii 10 kumasokonezanso kukula kwa chimanga.

section.title: Kukonza Mmunda wa Chimanga
content: Konzani mmunda wanu mofulumila kuti mubzyale chimanga chanu mofulumira.
Sosani, ndi kutipula bwino malo omwe mubzyalepo chimanga
Nthawi zambiri chimanga chimabzyalidwa pa mizere kapena ngati ndiulimi wa thilira chimanga chimabzyalidwa pa mndandanda pomwe phando ndi phando linzake litalikilane ma sentimitala 75.

section.title: Kabzyalidwe Koyenela
content: Chimanga chomwe chalimidwa ndi Mvula, bzyalani ndi Mvula yoyamba pamene dothi lanyowa kufikira masentimitala 15. Nthawiyi ikhoza kukhala mu Okutoba kapena Disemba
Ngati ndi ulimi wa nthilira bzyalani pamene nthaka yanyowa bwino kufikira ma sentimitala 15.
Bzyalani njere ya chimanga imodzi pa mapando otalikilana ma sentimitala 25 pa nzere yomwe yatalikilana ma sentimitala 75.
Mukhoza kubzyalanso njere ziwiri za chimanga pa phando lomwe latalikilana ndi linzake masentimitala 50 pa mizere yomwe yatalikilana masentimitala 75.
Mliminso akhoza kubzyala njere zitatu za chimanga pa masentimitala 50 pa phando lomwe latalikilana ndi linzake masentimitala 75.
Pa hekitala imodzi mlimi abzyale chimanga chochuluka makiligalamu 25 kapena makilogalamu 10 pa ekala

section.title: Kathilidwe ka Feteleza
content: Feteleza Obaya pa Nzere athilidwe pa nthawi yomwe chimanga chikubzyalidwa kapena chitabzyalidwa kapena patatha masiku asanu kapena asanu ndi awiri pamene mmera watuluka.

section.title: Kuchotsa Udzu Mmunda mwa Chimanga
content: Onetsetsani kuti mmunda wa chimanga mulibe udzu
Mmunda mukhale mulibe udzu kwa masabata awiri kufikira asanu ndi limodzi chitulukileni mmera wanu
Kupalira kawiri kapena katatu chibzyalileni ndi kokwanira
Kuchotsa udzu kukhoza kutheka ndi manja kapena kugwilitsa ntchito mankhwala
Ulima wa kasinthasintha ndi njira zina zamakolo zimathandizanso kuti udzu usamachulukane mmunda

section.title: Kuteteza Chimanga ku matenda komanso tizilombo
content: Tizilombo ta mbozi zonga tchembere zandonda, kapuchi, mbozi, mphunzi komanso chiswe zimaononga chimanga

Matenda ndi tizilombo toononga chimanga tingathe pobzyala mbewu yopilira kumatenda ndi kutizilombo, pothira mankhwala mmunda ngati kuli koyenera kutero komanso potsatila ulimi wamakono monga; ulimi wa kasinthasintha, kubzyala moyambilira, kubzyala zuchuluka pa malo ochepa zomwe zimachepetsa zotsatila za matenda komanso tizilombo

section.title: Kukolora Chimanga
content: Kololani chimanga chanu chitauma bwino
Chimanga chiikidwe pa mkuku kuti chiume bwino lomwe
Chikauma, chotsani chimanga ku mapesi kuti chitonoledwe ndikusungidwa bwino lomwe kapena kukagwilitsa ntchito.

section.title: Kusunga Chimanga
content: Sungani chimanga chouma komanso chosankhidwa bwino
Chimanga chomwe chisungidwe chikuyenera kuthilidwa makhwala ndi mulingo oyenera komanso motsatira ndondomeko yake

section.title: Kasankhidwe ka Mtundu wa Mbewu
content: CG7 amachita bwino mu nyengo zosiyana siyana
Nsinjiro ndi Chalimbana 2005 amachita bwino ku madera a mapiri
Mitundu yocha msanga monga Kakoma, Baka ndi Chitala imachita bwino ku madera a mmbali mwa Nyanja komanso ku chigwa cha Mtsinje wa Shire.
CG8, CG9, CG10 ndi CG11, amacha mwa pakatikati, masiku 120 ndi 130 ndipo amachita bwino ku madera okwelelapo pang'ono.
CG12, CG13, ndi CG14 ndi wocha msanga. Amatenga pakati pa masiku 90 ndi 110 ndipo amachita bwino ku madera omwe ndi a kuchigwa

section.title: Komwe mungapeze mbewu yanu
content: Mabungwe a kafukufuku wa zaulimi
Ma kampani ogulitsa mbewu omwe ndi wovomelezeka ndi boma

Ma bungwe omwe amagulitsa zipangizo za ulimi – awa ndi ndi omwe ali odalilika. Kubweleza mbewu ya mtedza ndikovomelezeka ngati ingabzyalidwe nyengo ziwiri. Ngati mlimi wagula mbewu yovomelezeka kwa nthawi yoyamba, akhoza kusankha mbewu ina pa kholola lake ndikuibzyala kwa zaka  zina ziwiri zotsatizana koma chaka chinacho(chachinayi) akuyenera kudzagula mbewu ya tsopano chifukwa akabweleza ya kale yomweyo, kholola lake lidzayamba kuchepa. Chomwecho, wonetsetsani kuti mbewu yanu mwaiyesa kuti mutsimikizike kuti ikamera bwino.

section.title: Malo Oyenera Kulima Mtedza
content: Sankhani dothi lokhathamila, losakanikilana pang'ono ndi mchenga komanso lopanda lowe. Mtedza ungachitenso bwino pa dothi la dongo losakanikilana pang'ono ndi mchenga komanso manyowa. Onetsetsani kuti simunalime mtedza wanu pa malo omwe asanalimidwepo chiyambile chifukwa malowa samakhala ndi mchere wa lizobiyamu omwe umathandiza kubeleka mandolo pa mtedza wanu. Kuyeza dothi ku malo ovomelezeka kungathandize kuti mudziwe ngati dothi lanu ndi loyenera kulimapo mtedza kapena ndilofunika kulikonzanso.

section.title: Kukonza Mmunda wa Mtedza
content: Konzani mmunda wanu mofulumila kuti mubzyale mtedza wanu ndi mvula yoyamba motsatila ndondomeko yobzyalilamtedza.
Mizere yanu ikhale yothasalala pamwamba, utalike masentimitala 30 komanso nzere ndi nzere unzake usiyane ndi masentimitala 75.

section.title: Kusakaniza mbewu ya mtedza ndi Feteleza wa Chilengedwe wa  inokulanti ndi makhwala ena musanabzyale.
content: Musanabzyale mbewu ya mtedza, wonetsetsani kuti mwayisakaniza ndi feteleza wa chilengedwe wa inokulanti kuti muonjezele michele yofunika mthaka yomwe imathandizila kuti mukolole zochuluka.
Makhwala a fungicide amateteza mbewu yanu and mmera wa mtedza kuti utuluke bwino chifukwa makhwalawa amateteza ku matenda opezeka mu dothi.

section.title: Kabzyalidwe Koyenela
content: Bzyalani mbewu ya mtedza njere imodzi ndipo phando lililonse litalikilane ndilinzake ma sentimitala 10 ngati ndi mbewu ya Spanish, masentimitala 15 ngati ndi mbewu ya  Virginia panzere okula masentimita pakati pa 5 ndi 6.

Ikakhala mbewu ya Spanish mukhoza kubzyala mbewu yochuluka ma kilogalamu 50 kapena 70 pa hekitala koma ngati ndi mbewu ya Viginiya mukhoza kubzyala mbewu yochuluka pakati pa 80 kapena 100 pa hekitala izi zingachitike ngati mukubzala mndandanda umodzi pa mzere uliwonse. Ngati mukubzyala mbali ziwiri pa mzere uliwonse, bzyalani mbewu yochuluka makilogalamu a pakati pa 110 ndi 130 pa hekitala ngati ndi mbewu ya Spanish, koma ngati ndi mbewu ya Viginiya, bzyalani mbewu yochuluka makilogalamu 180 kapena 200 pa hekitala ngati mukubzyala mbali zones ziwiri za mzere.

Ngati ulimi wanu ndi wodalira mvula, musabzyale mtedza wanu ngati padutsa pa 15 Januwale chifukwa ngati mungabzyale kudutsa masikuwa mbewu yanu singachite bwino chifukwa cha kuchuluka kwa nsabwe zomwe zimafalitsa matenda a khate. Kubzyala mochedwa kungakumanenso ndi ng'amba mu ulimi wanu zomwe zingapangitse kuti mtedza wanu usakhale ndi mandolo ochuluka komanso kuchepetsa zokolora kuti zichepe komanso kukhala ndi chuku.
Ngati mwabzyala pa malo a thyathyathya mbewu zanu zitalikilane ma sentimitala 45.

section.title: Kathilidwe ka Feteleza
content: Mtedza umachita bwino pamene nthaka ili kale ya chonde kotero kuti nthawi zambiri sipafunika kuthiranso feteleza ngati walimidwa pa munda okozedwa bwino komanso mtedza ungachite bwino ngati mwalima pamalo omwe pali feteleza wa chaka chapita.

Mmadera omwe chonde ndi chochepa, kuthira feteleza ndikoyenera kuti zokolora zichuluke. Feteleza wa Gipisamu ochuluka 100 kilogalamu athilidwe pa hekitala imodzi koma ngati ndi ekala, feteleza ochuluka ma kilogalamu 40 akhoza kuthilidwa ndipo izi zikhoza kuchitika musanabzyale kapena pa nthawi yomwe mukubzyala mtedza wanu
Fetelezayu athilidwe mu mndandanda wa nzere kapena awazidwe pa nthaka ndi kuundidwa limodzi pa nthawi yomwe mizere ikupangidwa.
Alimi akhoza kuthilanso Gipisamu 200 kilogalamu pa hekitala imodzi kapena 80 kilogalamu pa ekala pa nthawi yomwe pafupifupi theka ya mtedza wanu yayamba maluwa kapena mandolo.

section.title: Kuchotsa Udzu Mmunda wa Mtedza
content: Pakatha masabata atatu kapena asanu ndi limodzi, mlimi akuyenera kupalira
Kuzulira udzu ndikoyenera pamene mtedza wayamba kutulutsa mandoro
Kupopela makhwala othandiza kuzi udzu usamera ndi njira inanso yotchipa komanso yosavuta poonetsetsa kuti mmunda mulibe udzu.
Ulima wa kasinthasintha ndi njira zina zamakolo zimathandizanso kuti udzu usamachulukane mmunda.

section.title: Kuteteza Mtedza ku matenda komanso tizilombo
content: Mtedza umavutika ndi chiwawu chodza msanga komanso mochedwa, nthomba, dzimbiri, khate, nsabwe za mmasamba komanso mbozi za mmasamba.

Matenda ndi tizilombo toononga mtedza tingathe pobzyala mbewu yopilira kumatenda ndi kutizilombo, pothira mankhwala mmunda ngati kuli koyenera kutero komanso potsatila ulimi wamakono monga; ulimi wa kasinthasintha, kubzyala moyambilira, kubzyala zuchuluka pa malo ochepa zomwe zimachepetsa zotsatila za matenda komanso tizilombo, kuchotsa ndi kukwilira tsosa lomwe linagwidwa ndi matenda, pobzyala mbewu za makono monga CG8, CG9, CG10, CG11, CG12, CG13 ndi CG14 zomwe ndi zopilira ku matenda.

section.title: Kukolora Mtedza
content: Nyengo youma ndiyoyenera panthawi yomwe mukukolora mtedza.
Kololani mtedza wanu pamene wacha kuti mupewe kuonongeka kwa mtedza chifukwa cha chuku komanso kuthothoka kwa mandolo a mtedza.

Kuti mudziwe nthawi yomwe mukuyenera kukolora mtedza wanu, ndikoyenera kusunga masiku kuyambira pomwe mwabzyala mtedza wanu ndikutsatira bwino lomwe masiku oyenera kucha mtedza wanu molingana ndi mtundu wa mbewu. Muthanso kuona mmene akuonekera mandolo a mtedza wanu – Mtedza wanu ukacha umaoneka madodo ofililapo.
Umitsani masangwe a mtedza wanu kwa sabata imodzi (potengera nyengo) ukanali kumunda potsata njira zosiyana siyana monga njira ya Mandela.
Chotsani mtedza wanu ku masangwe ndi kuuyanikabe pokonzekera kuusunga.

section.title: Kusunga Mtedza
content: Mtedza umasungudwa bwino usanasendedwe uli mmatumba utaikidwa pa malo ouma bwino, osadontha, opitamphepo ndi otalikilanapo pang'ono ndi khoma.
Kusunga mtedza wosenda, wosweka, owora, komanso wa chuku sizoyenera.
Onetsetsani kuti mwasiya mpata pakati pa matumba anu ndi cholinga choti pazipita mphepo komanso musasanje matumba opitilira 10 pa malo amodzi.

section.title: Kuswa/Kusenda Mtedza
content: Mtedza ukuyenera kusendedwa pokhapokha ngati ugwilitsidwe ntchito kapena ukupita ku nsika womwe akufuna  mtedza wosenda kale.
Mtedza osenda kale suchedwa kuonongeka ndi tizilombo kapena kupanga chuku ndipo zotsatira zake umayamba chuku.
Onetsetsani kuti mwasiya mpata pakati pa matumba anu ndi cholinga choti pazipita mphepo komanso musasanje matumba opitilira 10 pa malo amodzi.

section.title: Kasankhidwe ka Mtundu wa Mbewu
content: Tikolore ndi Solitera  ndi mitundu ya Soya yomwe imayanja  madera osiyanasiyana.
Makwacha, Nasoko, Serenade, Soprano, ndi Pan 1867 amachita bwino ku madera okwelelapo pang'ono komanso okwera.
Ocepara 4 amachita bwino ku madera okwelelapo pang'ono.
Mitundu ina ya mbewu ya soya yomwe imapatsa kholora lochuluka ikanayesedwabe ndipo ikatsimikizika ipelekedwa kwa alimi.
Nthawi yomwe mbewu imacha, chikoka cha mbewu pa nsika komanso kuchuluka kwa kholora ndi zina zomwe alimi amaganizira akafuna kusankha mbewu.

section.title: Komwe mungapeze mbewu yanu
content: Mabungwe a kafukufuku wa zaulimi
Ma kampani ogulitsa mbewu omwe ndi wovomelezeka ndi boma

Kubweleza mbewu ya Soya ndikovomelezeka ngati ingabzyalidwe nyengo ziwiri. Mwa chitsanzo, ngati mlimi wagula mbewu yovomelezeka kwa nthawi yoyamba, akhoza kusankha mbewu ina pa kholola lake ndikuibzyala kwa zaka  zina ziwiri zotsatizana koma chaka chinacho(chachinayi) akuyenera kudzagula mbewu ya tsopano chifukwa akabweleza ya kale yomweyo, kholora lake lidzayamba kuchepa. Chomwecho, wonetsetsani kuti mbewu yanu mwaiyesa kuti mutsimikizike kuti ikamera bwino.

section.title: Malo omwe mungalime Soya
content: Malo akhale a mtsetse pangono
Pakhale dothi la makande komanso lopanda lowe
Akhale malo omwe sipanalimidwepo soya kwa zaka ziwiri za mbuyomo
Musalime soya pa malo omwe panalimidwa fodya
Limani Soya pa malo pomwe palibe dothi la udzimbiri komanso udzu oyanga.

section.title: Kukonza Mmunda
content: Konzani munda wanu mofulumira ndicholinga choti mubzyale ndi mvula yoyamba molingana ndi ndondomeko ya kabzyalidwe yomwe mwasankha.
Mizere yanu ikhale yothasalala pamwamba, utalike masentimitala 30 komanso nzere ndi nzere unzake usiyane ndi masentimitala 75.

section.title: Kusakaniza mbewu ya Soya ndi inokulanti ndi makhwala ena musanabzyale.
content: Musanabzyale mbewu ya soya, wonetsetsani kuti mwayisakaniza ndi feteleza wachilengedwe wa inokulanti kutimuonjezele michele yofunika nthaka yomwe imathandizila kuti mukolole zochuluka.
Mukathira makhwala a Fungicide ku mbewu ya Soya, amateteza mbewu yanu ndi mmera wa soya kuti utuluke bwino chifukwa makhwalawa amateteza ku matenda opezeka mu dothi.

section.title: Kabzyalidwe Koyenela ka Soya
content: Bzyalani njere ya Soya imodzi pa phando lililonse ndipo litalikilane ndilinzake ma sentimitala 5. Ngati mwabzyala mbali zonse ziwiri za mzere, pakati pobzyalidwapo patalikilane masentimitala 2.5 kapena 3.

Ikakhala mbewu ya Tikolore, bzyalani mbewu yochuluka ma kilogalamu 60 kapena 65 pa hekitala koma ngati ndi mbewu ya Makwacha kapena Nasoko, bzyalani mbewu yochuluka pakati pa 80 kapena 100 pa hekitala
Mbewu ya Soya ikhoza kulimidwa nthawi ya chilimwe (Desembala mpaka Epulo) kapena nthawi ya mwavu (Meyi kapena Juni) pogwilitsa ntchito ulimi wa thilira kapena chinyezi cha kudimba.

Ngati ndi ulimi wa nthilira, bzyalani Soya wanu mu Meyi kapena Juni pa malo a chigwa komanso ouma. Dziwani kuti ngati mwalima Soya wanu nthawi ya mwavu, zokolora zanu zikhoza kukhala zochepa chifukwa cha kuchepa kwa kulandira kuwala kwa dzuwa komwe kumathandiza kaphikidwe ka chakudya cha mbewu zanu.

Potengera mtundu wa mbewu ya Soya yomwe mwasankha komanso ndi mbewu zomwe zakhala zikubzyalidwa pa munda wanu, mlimi wa Soya angathe kuphatikira mbewu yake ndi ndi feteleza wa chilengedwe wa inokulanti pa nthawi yomwe akubzyala.
Mbewu ya Tikolore singafune inoculanti pamene mitundu ina yonse ya mbewu ya Soya ikhoza kufuna fetelezayu.
Ngati pa munda pomwe mwabzyala Soya wanu panalimidwanso Soya zaka zitatu zapitazo, sipangafunike feteleza wina chifukwa kuti nthaka ikanali ya moto.
Pali mitundu yosiyanasiyana ya feteleza wa inokulanti yemwe mungamupeze pa nsika ndipo mndandanda wa mitunduyi walembedwa mmasamba ena mmusimu.

section.title: Kathilidwe ka Feteleza:
content: Nthawi zambiri, Soya ngati mbewu za mgulu la nyemba zimadzipangila zokha michere yofunika mu nthaka. Koma ngati pafunika feteleza, mtundu woyenera kuthira mmunda wa Soya zimatengera ndi mmene dothi lake liliri.

Ngati ndi kofunika kutero, thilani ma kilogalamu 100 pa hekitala pogwilitsa ntchito feteleza wa chitowe wa 23:10:5+4S kapena D-Kompaundi. Ngati mukugwilitsa njira yothila  feteleza motsata nzere ikani makilogalamu ochuluka 18 pa mita iliyonse.

section.title: Kuchotsa udzu mmunda wa Soya
content: Palilani munda wanu pakatha masabata awiri kuchoka pamene mwabzyala Soya wanu. Kupalira kotsatira kukhoza kuchitika ngati udzu wayamba kuoneka mmunda wanu.
Ngati mwathira makhwala opha udzu pa nthawi yobzyara, kupalira kamodzi kukhoza kuchitika patatha masabata asanu kapena asanu ndi limodzi ngakhale kuti nthawi zina kupalilaku sikungafunike.
Kulima mbewu mwakasinthasintha kumathandizanso kuti udzu usamachuluke mmunda.

section.title: Kuteteza Soya ku matenda komanso tizilombo
content: Thilani mankhwala (Folicur) kuti methane ndi dzimbiri.
Mavuto a kafota akhoza kuchepa ngati mlimi akutsatira njira za ulimi zamakono, kusamala mmunda komanso kubzyala mbewu yovomelezeka.
Tizilombo monga mbozi, mbozi zobiliwira, mbozi za mmasamba, komanso chiswe zingatetezedwe ngati mlimi akutsatira njira za ulimi zamakono, kusamala mmunda komanso kubzyala mbewu yovomelezeka.
Thilani mankhwala a Cypermethrin kapena Dimethoete ngati tizilomboti tafika povuta.

section.title: Kukolora ndi Kupuntha Soya
content: Kololani Soya wanu mmawa akangochoka mame komanso pamene kukanazizira kuti soya wanu asamwazike.
Umitsani zokolora zanu pa thandala lomwe lakonzedwa bwino
Punthani ndi manja pogwilitsa nthito ndodo kapena punthani soya wanu pogwilitsa ntchito zipangizo zina zamakono.

section.title: Kukonza komanso Kusankha Soya
content: Mbewu ya Soya imakozedwa popeta komanso kusankha ndi kuchotsa mbewu yoora, yakuda, yosweka, yamatenda komanso yodyedwa ndi tizilombo. Zitsotso ndi mbewu zina zomwe za sakanikilana ndi Soya wanu zikuyenera kuchotsedwa ndi kuikidwa pambari.

section.title: Kusunga kholora la Soya
content: Kusunga kholora la Soya zimathandiza mlimi kudzagulitsa pa nthawi yomwe mitengo ili yokwera.
Kholora la Soya likuyenera kusungidwa mmatumba olemera ma kilogalamu 50 kapena 100 ndikuikidwa pa zithandala zomwe zakozedwa bwino komanso malo opita mphepo.
Sungani matumba a Soya wanu pa malo osadontha ndi opanda chinyezi ndipo asakhale pansi komanso atalikilane ndi khoma.

section.title: Kasankhidwe ka Mtundu wa Mbewu ya Mpendadzuwa
content: PAN 7351, PAN 7049, PAN 7033 yomwe ndi mbewu yamakono imachita bwino ku madera okwelelapo pang'ono.
Milika ndi mbewu yomwe imafalikira mosavuta ndipo alimi akhoza kuitanitsa mbewuyi  kuchokera ku Zambia ndi cholinga chochulukitsa mbewuyi.
Mbewu ya makolo ikhoza kubzyalidwa ndipo mlimi akuyenera kusankha mbewu yabwino, yokhwima yomwe ingatengedwe kuchokera ku mbewu yogonera kapena yomwe yangochokera kumunda kumene.
Mitundu ina ya mbewu ikuunikidwabe ndipo zones  zikatha idzapelekedwa kwa alimi.
Nthawi yomwe mbewu imacha, chikoka cha mbewu pa nsika komanso kuchuluka kwa kholora ndi zina zomwe alimi amaganizira akafuna kusankha mbewuyi.

section.title: Komwe mungapeze mbewu yanu
content: Mabungwe a kafukufuku wa zaulimi
Ma kampani ogulitsa mbewu omwe ndi wovomelezeka ndi boma
Ma bungwe omwe amagulitsa zipangizo za ulimi – awa ndi odalilika

Kubweleza mbewu ya Mpendadzuwa ndikovomelezeka ngati ingabzyalidwe nyengo ziwiri. Mwa chitsanzo, ngati mlimi wagula mbewu yovomelezeka kwa nthawi yoyamba, akhoza kusankha mbewu ina pa kholola lake ndikuibzyala kwa zaka zina ziwiri zotsatizana koma chaka chinacho(chachinayi) akuyenera kudzagula mbewu ya tsopano chifukwa akabweleza ya kale yomweyo, kholora lake lidzayamba kuchepa. Chomwecho, wonetsetsani kuti mbewu yanu mwaiyesa kuti mutsimikizike kuti ikamera bwino.

section.title: Malo omwe mungalime Mpendadzuwa
content: Sankhani dothi lokhathamila, losakanikilana pang'ono ndi mchenga komanso lopanda lowe.
Sankhani dothi lokhathamila, losakanikilana pang'ono ndi mchenga komanso lopanda lowe.
Mpendadzuwa amachita bwino ngati kuchuluka kwa michere kuli pakati pa 6.5 ndi 7.5.
Wonetsetsani kuti mukuchita ulimi wa kasithasitha kuti mupewe matenda, tizilombo toononga Mpendadzuwa komanso kuchepetsa kuchuluka kwa udzu.

section.title: Kukonza Mmunda wa Mpendadzuwa
content: Konzani mmunda wanu mwachangu kuti mubzyale mu nthawi yabwino
Mpandadzuwa umachita bwino ngati dothi la mmunda wanu mwalikonza bwino (likhale lopanda mabuma).
Ngati mwabzyala popanda mabuma ndiye kuti mbewu yanu imera mosavuta komanso iima bwino.
Ngati mukubzyala mmizere, onetsetsani kuti ndiyotalikilana masentimitala 75 ndikutalika masentimitala 30.

section.title: Kusakaniza mbewu ya Mpendadzuwa ndi makhwala musanabzyale.
content: Musanabzyale mbewu ya Mpendadzuwa ndi makhwala omwe amathana ndi fangasi
Makhwalawa amateteza mbewu yanu komanso mmera wanu kuti usagwidwe ndi fangasi kuti mukhale ndi kholora lochuluka.

section.title: Kabzyalidwe Koyenela ka Mpendadzuwa
content: Bzyalani njere imodzi ya Mpendadzuwa pa phando lililonse ndipo litalikilane ndilinzake ma sentimitala 25 kapena njere ziwire pamaphando otalikilana ma sentimitala 50.
Ngati mwabzyala malo a thyathyathya, bzyalani pa mndandanda umodzi wotalikilana masentimitala 45
Pa hekitala imodzi mukhoza kubzyala mbewu yolemera makilogalamu 5 kapena makilogalamu awiri pa ekala.
Ngati mbewu yanu mwaitenga kuchokera ku zokolora, onetsetsani kuti mwabzyala mbewu yochuluka.
Mukhoza kubzyala Mpendadzuwa wanu nthawi ina iliyonse  mpakana kufika Febuluwale makamaka ku malo a chigwa komanso achinyezi.

Mpendadzuwa uli ndi kuthekera kogwilitsa ntchito michere yomwe inathilidwapo kale komanso yoti sinagwilitsidwe kwathunthu ndi mbewu zina zomwe zinalimidwa mmbuyomu. Mpendadzuwa ukhoza kulimidwanso motsatana ndi mbewu zina monga chimanga kapena mapira. Izi zimaoneka kawiri kawiri ku dera la kumtunda kwa mtsinje wa Shire minga ku Phalombe, Chiradzulu komanso Blantyre pomwenso mbewuyi imapindula ndi feteleza yemwe anathilidwa ku mbewu zinazi.

section.title: Kathilidwe ka Feteleza
content: Mtundu woyenera wa feteleza yemwe angathilidwe mmunda wa Mpendadzuwa zimatengera ndi mmene dothi lake liliri.
Ngati ndi kofunika kutero, thilani ma kilogalamu 150 pa hekitala pogwilitsa ntchito feteleza wa chitowe wa 23:10:5+4S kapena 100kilogalamu wa Urea
Alimi akulimbikitsidwa kuthira feteleza yemwe ali ndi Boron pa malo omwe palibe Boron chifukwa michere imeneyi imalimbikitsa kukula bwino kwa mbewu.
Thilani feteleza wa 23:21:0+4S panthawi yomwe mukubzyala kapena pakapita masiku 10 kuchokera pamene mwabzyala kuti mbewuyi utulutse mizu yabwino.
Thilani Urea pakapita masiku 14 kuchokera pamene mwathira feteleza oyamba kapena mwachotsa nthambi kapena mbewu zina zosafunikila.

Dziwani kuti madera ambiri komwe kumalimidwa Mpendadzuwa, alimi sathila feteleza. Komabe kuti mlimi akolore zochuluka ndipofunika kuthira feteleza mmunda wa Mpendadzuwa kuonjezera apo ndikofunika kutero ngati mlimi wagwilitsa mbewu ya makono.

section.title: Kuchotsa udzu mmunda wa Mpendadzuwa
content: Onetsetsani kuti mmunda wanu mulibe udzu masabata 6 mutangobzyala.
Palilani ndi khasu pakapita ma sabata 2 kuchokera pamene mwabzyala. Kukonza mmunda kotsatira kungachitike pamene udzu waoneka mmunda.
Ngati mwathira makhwala opha udzu pa nthawi yobzyara, kupalira kamodzi kukhoza kuchitika patatha masabata asanu kapena asanu ndi limodzi kuchokera pamene mwabzyala
Kulima mbewu mwakasinthasintha kumathandizanso kuti udzu usamachuluke mmunda.

section.title: Kuteteza Mpendadzuwa ku matenda komanso tizilombo:
content: Pali gulu la tizilombo komanso matenda osiyanasiyana omwe amagwira Mpendadzuwa ngakhale kuti izi siziopseza mulingo wa kholora.

Matenda omwe amagwila Mpendadzuwa kawirikawiri nd Sclerotinia Head rot – omwe amaoneka kuda ndi kufota pa chibalo cha Mpendadzuwa. Matendawa angapewedwe ngati mlimi akutsatira njira za ulimi zamakono, kusamala mmunda komanso kubzyala mbewu yovomelezeka.
Tizilombo monga ziwala, mbozi, zingathe pomwe mlimi wathira mankhwala oyenera.

section.title: Kukhwima Komanso Kukolora Mpendadzuwa
content: Mpendadzuwa umakhala kuti wacha ngati mutu wa chibalo chake wasintha maonekedwe kuchoka ku biliwira ndikumaoneka chikasu komanso masamba a kunja kwa chibalo amayamba kufota.
Chibalo komanso mtengo wa mpendadzuwa umakhalabe wauwisi.
Kololani mpendadzuwa wanu pamene chibalo chake chikanali chachiwisi komanso chogwilana kuti mungataye kholora lochuluka.
Ngati palibe vuto la Mbalame kudya mpendadzuwa, lolani kuti mbewu yanu iche ikanali chiyimilire pa mtego wake
Ngati mbewu yanu ikololedwa isanaumiletu, dulani chibalo chake ndikuyika pa malo mogadamitsa ndikumaisanduliza ngati izi zingafunike kutero.
Kuumitsaku kuchitike pakati pa masiku 5 kapena 8.

section.title: Kupuntha ndi Kusankha Mpendadzuwa
content: Mpendadzuwa ukauma. Punthani ndi timitengo tokonzedwa bwino kapena pa thabwa mwinanso ndi zida zina zamakono

Mbewuyi ipetedwe kuti makoko ndi zina zosafunika zichoke
Kusankha kumathandiza kuti isachite chuku komanso isaphatikane ndi tizilombo.
Mpendadzuwa uume kufika pa chinyezi cha mapelesenti 12 ngati musunge kwa nthawi yochepa kapena ma pelesenti 9 ngati musunge kwa miyezi iwiri kapena itatu.

section.title: Kusunga Mpendadzuwa
content: Kusunga kholora la Mpendadzuwa zimathandiza mlimi kudzagulitsa pa nthawi yomwe mitengo ili yokwera.
Kholora la Mpendadzuwa likuyenera kusungidwa mmatumba osamalika komanso othilidwa makhwala kuti mbewuyi isaonongeke.
Mbewuyi ikhoza kusungidwa mmatumba olemera ma kilogalamu 50 kapena 100 ndikuikidwa pa zithandala zomwe zakozedwa bwino komanso malo opita mphepo.
Sungani matumba a Mpendadzuwa wanu pa malo osadontha ndi opanda chinyezi ndipo asakhale pansi komanso atalikilane ndi khoma.

section.title: Kamangidwe ka khola
content: Gwiritsani ntchito zipangizo zolimba komanso zosavuta kupeza pomanga khola la ng’ombe monga bulugama, nsungwi ndi udzu ofolelera denga.
Ikani simenti pansi pa khola lanu kuti musamavutike pokolopa kuti mupewe tizilombo toyambitsa matenda
Ng'ombe imodzi yaikulu imafuna khola lomangidwa 2.1m mulifupi, 2.1m mulitali, 2.4m mumsinkhu

section.title: Mitundu ya ng'ombe za nyama yovomerezeka
content: Malawian Zebu, Brahman ndi mitundu yochokera pokwatitsidwa.

section.title: Mitundu ya kawetedwe ka ng'ombe za nyama
content: Ngombe zimawetedwa potsatira kadyetsedwe. Pali mitundu iwiri. Kudyetsera kumadambo kapena mukhola
Kudyetsa ng'ombe mozitaya: Ngombe zimatha kudyetsedwa ku madambo pa nthawi yomwe anthu alima, komanso mminda anthu akakolola
Kudyetsera ng'ombe ku malo otetezedwa: Ng'ombe zimadyetsedwa mukhola ndikupatsidwa chakudya chopangidwa mwa padera kwa masiku 50 osapitilira 150 kuti zinenepe mokwanira zisanaphedwe.

section.title: Kadyetsedwe ka ng’ombe za nyama
content: Onetsetsani kuti munthawi ya dzinja, ng'ombe zikudya mmadambo kwa maola osachepera 8 pamene munthawi ya mvula ziyenera kudya kwa maola 5.
Wazani madzi a mchere kapena molasesi ku mapesi kapena ku masangwe kuti chakudya chigaike bwino m’mimba mwa ng’ombe.
Mwetsani ng’ombe madzi aukhondo nthawi zonse.
Gwiritsani ntchito chakudya choonjezera .Perekani 4-5kg ya chakudya choonjezera kwa ng'ombe imodzi pa tsiku kuti zikule mwathanzi
Alimi ayenera kudzala chakudya cha udzu ndi mtundu wa nyemba ndipo achisunge kapena kufutsa kuti adzagwiritse ntchito mtsogolo

section.title: Ziyang'aniro pochulukitsa ng'ombe za nyama
content: Ng'ombe yaimuna imayenera ikhale yathanzi komanso yokula nsanga, yobadwa kwa makolo amphamvu, isakhale yonenepa kwambiri kapena yoonda kwambiri, ikhale yopanda matenda
Ng'ombe yaikazi ikhale yochokera kwa ng'ombe imene imatenga bere pachaka, ikhale ndi mabere omwe alibe vuto lililonse, mwana wang'ombe adzioneka wathanzi pomusiitsa kuyamwa, ikhale yopanda matenda
Ngo'mbe yaimuna imodzi iyenera kukwera ng'ombe 30-40 zazikazi.
Ngombe zimene sizinaberekepo ziyenera kukweredwa moyambilira kenako zazikulu zingathe kukweredwanso.
Kuchurukitsa ng'ombe kuyenera kuyamba mwezi wa January mpakana May kuti padzakhale chakudya chokwanira panthawi imene ng'ombe idzabereke

section.title: Kusamalira ng'ombe pobereka
content: Siyanitsani ng’ombe yanu yabere ndi zinzake pakangotsala sabata imodzi kuti ibereke pofuna kuyiyang’anira bwino
Onetsetsani zizindikiro zofuna kubereka monga ngati izi: kulendewera kwabere, chikazi chotuwa chonanda, kusakhala ndichilakolako chachakudya komanso kusowa mtendere
Dulani ndi kumanga mchombo ndikupakapo  ayodini mothandizidwa ndi alangizi aziweto. Izi zimathendiza kuchepetsa tizilombo toyambitsa matenda ku ziweto, komanso kuti bala lipole nsanga

section.title: Kusamalira ana a ng'ombe
content: Onetsetsani kuti mwapuputa mmaso, mkamwa ndi mphuno mwa mwana wongobadwa kumeneyo pofuna kuchepetsa imfa za ana a ng’ombe komanso wanyambitidwa ndi mayi wake zimene zimathandizira kuti mwana wa ng'ombe ayimilire.
Ngati mwanayo wabadwa ndi chilema adziwitseni a dotolo a ziweto.
Onetsetsani kuti mwana wayamwa mkaka oyambirira kwa masiku anayi.
Patulirani ana ang’ombe pakatha miyezi isanu ndi umodzi kapena isanu ndi itatu atangobadwa ndipo adyetsedwe zakudya zolimbitsa chifu.
Mwetsani mankwala anjoka za mmimba munthawi yake ku ana a ng'ombe
Ana aamuna omwe sagwiritsidwa ntchito pokwatitsa kapena kuchulukitsa ng'ombe ayenera kiutenedwa kuti anenepe

section.title: Kuthana ndi matenda a ng'ombe za nyama
content: Ng'ombe za nyama zimagwidwa ndi matenda osiyanasiyana omwe amakhudza kabweredwe ka ndalama pa ulimi wathu
Ena mwa matendawa ndi khunyu, matenda apakhungu, matenda ogwira kukamwa ndi miyendo, matenda ochepetsa magazi ndi ena ambiri.
Onetsetsani kuti mwadziwitsa alangizi aziweto akudera kwanu zamatenda omwe mwaona pa ng'ombe zanu kuti muthandizidwe.
Tsatani ndondomeko za kapewedwe ka matenda osiyanasiyana kuti ng'ombe zanu zikhale za thanzi

section.title: Tizilombo toyambitsa matenda(Nthanta)
content: Nthata zimayambitsa matenda osiyanasiyana amene amakhudza kapangidwe ka mkaka ku ng'ombe zathu
Gwiritsani ntchito mankhwala opha nkhupakupa

section.title: Tizilombo toyambitsa matenda(Njoka za mmimba)
content: Zizindikiro za matendawa ndi monga kutsegula m'mimba, kutupa mimba ndi kuchepa magazi.
Mwetsani ng'ombe mankhwala a njoka za mmimba koyambilira ndi komalizira kwa nyengo ya mvula
Sinthani malo odyetsera pakatha masabata 3-4 alionse, ukhondo

section.title: Kagulitsidwe ka ng'ombe za nyama
content: Onetsetsani kuti ng'ombe ikulemera pakati pa 350kg ndi 500kg kutengera mtundu wa ng'ombe
Fufuzani misika yodalirika komwe mungagulitse ng'ombe zanu pa mtengo wabwino
Gulitsani ng'ombe zanu pagulu kuti mukhale ndi mphamvu potchula mtengo wa katundu wanu
Misika ikuluikulu imafunika kuperekera katundu mosalekeza,kotero kukhala mmagulu a ulimi wa ng'ombe za nyama kungathandizire kupeza misika yotereyi kuti katundu akhale ochuluka

section.title: Zoyenera posunga kaundula wa zochitika pa famu ya ng’ombe za mkaka
content: Kaundula wa pa Famu ya ng’ombe za mkaka amathandiza kupanga chiganizo chokweretsa, kudyetsa ndi kuona momwe momwe ulimi wa ng’ombe za mkaka ukupindulira pa famupo.
Lemberani momwe ng’ombe ili yonse ikupangira mu bukhu payokha payokha.
Kaundulayu amathandizanso kutsatira zolowa ndi zotuluka pa ulimi wa mkaka.

section.title: Kamangidwe ka khola
content: Gwiritsani ntchito zipangizo zolimba komanso zosavuta kupeza pomanga khola la ng’ombe monga bulugama, nsungwi ndi udzu ofolelera denga.
Ikani simenti pansi pa khola lanu kuti musamavutike pokolopa kuti mupewe tizilombo toyambitsa matenda.
Ng'ombe ziwiri zazikulu zimafuna khola lomangidwa 3.7m mulifupi, 6.1m mulitali, 2.4m mumsinkhu

section.title: Muitundu ya ng'ombe za mkaka
content: Mitundu ya ng'ombe za mkaka yovomerezeka ndi Friesian,Holstein Friesian, Ayrshire, Jersey, Guernsey

section.title: Kadyetsedwe ka ng’ombe za mkaka
content: Chakudya choyenera cha ng’ombe zamkaka ndi udzu komanso zotsalila zakumunda monga nsenjere, lukina kapena masangwe a mtedza kapena soya. Ng’ombe zanu za mkaka muzizidyetsera m’khola nthawi zonse kuopetsa matenda.
Perekani 3 kilogalamu yachakudya pa 100 kilogalamu iliyose ya kulemera kwa ng’ombe yanu, mwachitsanzo ngati ng’ombe yanu imalemera 300 kilogalamu ipatseni chakudya cholemera 9 kilogalamu patsiku.
Wazani madzi a mchere kapena molasesi ku mapesi kapena ku masangwe kuti chakudya chigaike bwino m’mimba mwa ng’ombe.
Mwetsani ng’ombe madzi aukhondo nthawi zonse.

Gwiritsani ntchito chakudya choonjezera . Mungathe kuphatikiza 70kg ya chakudya chopatsa mphamvu ngati gaga ndi chimanga, 29kg chokulitsa ngati soya okazinga, 1 kg zoteteza ku matenda ndi mchere wa mthupi.
Perekani 2 kilogalamu ya chakudyachi pa ma lita asanu aliwonse a mkaka omwe ng’ombe ikupereka.

section.title: Kachulukitsidwe ndi Nsinkhu oyenerera
content: Gwiritsani ntchito njira yokweretsa popanda mphongo pokweretsa ng’ombe za mkaka pofuna kuti mwana obadwayo adzapereke mkaka kuposera makolo ake.
Gwiritsani ntchito nkhubzi yomwe yasankhidwa mothandizidwa ndi alangizi aziweto ngati jekeseni wasowa.
Msoti wa ng’ombe upatseni mphongo utakwanitsa miyezi nkhumi ndi isanu ndi itatu (18) komanso ikamalemera 300 kilogilamu ngati ndi Friesian kapena Holstein, komanso 230kilogilamu ngati ndi Jerseys.

section.title: Zizindikilo za Ng’ombe yofuna kukweredwa
content: Ng'ombe imasonyeza zizindikiro zotsatirazi: imakwera ng’ombe zinzake kapena ikamakweredwa ndi zinzake siimathawa, imangoyenda yenda, chikazi chimatuluka kumaliseche kwake, ngati ili yokamidwa imapereka mkaka ochepa, imangoliralira komanso maliseche ake amaoneka otupa ndi ofiira.
Chilakolako chimatha maola 6 mpakana kufika pa maola 30 ngati sinatenge bele chilakolakochi chimayambiranso pakatha masiku 21.
Kweretsani ng’ombe pakadutsa maola 6 kuyambira pamene yaonetsa zizindikiro zoyambirira zofuna mphongo.

Musakweretse ng’ombe yanu itabeleka kumene ngakhale itaonetsa zizindikiro zofuna mphongo koyamba chifukwa thanzi lake limakhala lisanabwerere. Kweretsani ng’ombe ikaonetsa zizindikirozi kachiwiri zimene zimaoneka pakatha miyezi iwiri kapena itatu itabereka.
Onetsetsani kuti ng’ombe yanu ikubereka chaka chilichonse.

section.title: Kusamalira ng'ombe pobereka
content: Lekani kukama mkaka ng’ombe yanu yanu yabere ili ikafika miyezi 7 ndipo mmalo mwake ipatseni zakudya zopatsa thanzi zokwana makilogalamu 2 mpaka 4 patsiku ng’ombe iliyonse.
Siyanitsani ng’ombe yanu yabere ndi zinzake pakangotsala sabata imodzi kuti ibereke pofuna kuyiyang’anira bwino
Onetsetsani zizindikiro zofuna kubereka monga ngati izi: kulendewera kwabere, chikazi chotuwa chonanda, kusakhala ndichilakolako chachakudya komanso kusowa mtendere
Yambani kuwapatsa ana ang’ombe zakudya za maudzu sabata lachitatu akangobadwa kuti zifu zawo zizolowere
Patulirani ana ang’ombe pakatha miyezi itatu kapena inayi atangobadwa
Dulani mphondo za ana a ng’ombe pakatha miyezi iwiri kapena itatu atangobadwa. Izi zimathandiza kuchepetsa ngozi, kuchepetsa ukali komanso ng'ombe zimafuna malo ochepa odyetsera

section.title: Momwe mungapangire kuti ng’ombe zanu zikhale za thanzi
content: Ulimi wa mkaka umakhudzidwa ndi matenda komanso tizilombo, choncho onetsetsani kuti mwateteza ng’ombe zanu ku matendawa komanso tizilomboti.
Matenda amene amabwezera m’mbuyo kuchuluka kwa mkaka ndi monga: Kusasa kwa mkaka, chifuwa chachikulu, Kupoloza, zilonda za mkamwa ndi mapazi komanso matenda amene amadza chifukwa cha akalumbalumba
Tetezani matendawa popeleka katemera mwamsanga komanso onetsetsani kuti mwazindikira mwachangu kuti ng’ombe ikudwala ndi kuithandiza msanga.
Tizilombo tomwe timavuta kwambiri ku ulimi wa ng’ombe za mkaka ndi monga; Nthata, nsabwe, kalumbalumba ndi njoka za mmimba.
Sambitsani kapena mwetsani ng’ombe zanu mankhwala ovomelezeka kuti muthane ndi tizilomboti
Limbikitsani ukhondo komanso kumanga makola a bwino pofuna kupewa matenda ndi tizilombo ku ziweto zanu.
Perekani chakudya ndi madzi aukhondo kuti ng’ombe zanu zikhale za thanzi labwino.
Letsani kulowa ndi kutuluka kwa ziweto m’khola mwanu. Chotsani ndi kupha ng’ombe zomwe zadwala nthawi yayitali mu khola mwanu. Kwirilani ng’ombe ndi ziwalo zoonongeka kuopetsa kufala kwa matenda.

section.title: Ukhondo wa kasamalidwe ndi kasungidwe ka mkaka
content: Onetsetsani kuti pokama mkaka siunasase m’mawere a ng’ombe. Ngati wasasa ikameni ng’ombeyo pamapeto pa zonse ndipo mkaka osasawo musaphatikize ndi wabwino
Tsukani mawere a ng’ombe ndi madzi ofunda komanso pukutani mawerewo ndi kansalu koyera.
Mangani mchira ndi miyendo ya ng’ombe nthawi yokama kuopa kutaya mkaka.
Onetsetsani kuti okama mkaka akhale wa thanzi ndi waukhondo nthawi zonse komanso asasute fodya pokama mkaka ndipo azimayi azivala zipewa pokama.
Gwiritsani ntchito ziwiya zopanda dzimbiri.
Khazikitsani nthawi zokamira mkaka. Osamasinthasintha.
Finyani mawere osati kukoka pokama mkaka.
Sefani mkaka nthawi yomwe mwangomaliza kukama mkaka pogwiritsa ntchito kansalu koyera bwino ngati mwagwera zitsotso
Sungani mkaka pa malo ozizira, otetezedwa bwino komanso kutali ndi mankhwala.
Kagulitseni mkaka mwachangu, m’mawa kapena madzulo nthawi yomwe kukuzizira kuopetsa kuti mkaka ungasase.

section.title: Tizilombo toyambitsa matenda(Nthata)
content: Nthata zimayambitsa matenda osiyanasiyana amene amakhudza kapangidwe ka mkaka ku ng'ombe zathu
Gwiritsani ntchito mankhwala opha nkhupakupa

section.title: Tizilombo toyambitsa matenda(Njoka za mmimba)
content: Zizindikiro za matendawa ndi monga kutsegula m'mimba, kutupa mimba ndi kuchepa magazi.
Mwetsani ng'ombe mankhwala a njoka za mmimba koyambilira ndi komalizira kwa nyengo ya mvula.
Sinthani malo odyetsera pakatha masabata 3-4 alionse, ukhondo.

section.title: Kusunga akaundula paulimi
content: Kaundula wa pa Famu ya ng’ombe za mkaka amathandiza kupanga chiganizo chokweretsa, kudyetsa ndi kuona momwe momwe ulimi wa ng’ombe za mkaka ukupindulira pa famupo.
Lemberani momwe ng’ombe ili yonse ikupangira mu bukhu payokha payokha.
Kaundulayu amathandizanso kutsatira zolowa ndi zotuluka pa ulimi wa mkaka.

section.title: Kamangidwe ka khola
content: Sankhani malo otetezedwa ku mbava ndi nyama zoononga nkhuku
Mangani khola molingana ndi kuchuluka kwa nkhuku zanu, mwachitsanzo nkhuku 10 mpaka 15 zimafunika khola lotalika mamita awiri mbali zonse.
Folerani denga la khola ndi udzu kapena malata kuti mkhola muzikhala mouma nthawi zonse
Gwiritsani ntchito zipangizo zomangira khola zopezeka mosavuta monga mitengo, njerwa, bango, mchenga, udzu ndi mazenera

section.title: Kasamalidwe ka khola
content: Ikani utuchi mkhola kuti nkhuku zizigona pabwino ndipo mudzisintha pamene pafunikira kutero kuti mukhale mwaukhondo
Konzani malo abwino oyikira nkhuku kuti mazira asasweke komanso azikhala aukhondo
Onetsetsani kuti mkhola ndi mwaukhondo nthawi zonse kuti muchepetse matenda

section.title: Kusankha ndi kupititsa patsogolo mtundu
content: Sankhani nkhuku zimene zimakula msanga, zazikuluzikulu, zothetha, komanso zolera bwino anapiye.
Kwatitsani nkhuku zalokolo ndii tambala wa Mikologwekuti zikhale zokula mwamsanga, zoyikira mazira ambiri ndi kupereka nyama yochuluka.
Tambala mmodzi wamikolongwe mpatseni nkhuku zazikazi khumi ndipo mudzibweretsa wina pakatha zaka ziwiri zirizonse.

section.title: Kasamalidwe ka mazila
content: Sungani mazira molozetsa mbali yaikulu kumwamba  pamalo ouma ndi aukhondo kuti dzira asaonongeke
Onetsetsani kuti mazira oyenera kufungatira akhale oti sanapitirire masiku 10 nkhuku zitayikira kuti adzaswe bwino
Mungathe kuswa anapiye ankhuku zalokolo pogwiritsa ntchito makina.

section.title: Zakudya ndi kadyetsedwe
content: Dyetselani mkhola nkhuku zalokolo kapena kuzitsekulira kuti zizipeza chakudya zokha
Zipatseni zakudya zowonjezera m’mawa ndi madzulo monga madeya, chimanga, zakudya zotsalira kukhitchini, ndiwo za masamba, ndi zakudya zopanga nokha kuti nkhuku zikule mwa thanzi
Zidyetseni zikhokhombe za mazira zopera kuti zidzaikire mazira azikhokhombe zolimba.
Sungani anapiye osapitirira masabata asanu ndi imodzi (6) mkhola kuti adzipatsidwa chakudya chokwanira komanso choyenera. zikule bwino ndi kuopa kudyedwa
Zipatseni madzi abwino nkhuku nthawi zonse kuti zisatethedwe

section.title: Kapangidwe ka chakudya ka nkhuku za lokolo
content: Tengani magawo awiri amgaiwa kapena madeya a chimanga
Phatikizani ku gawo limodzi la ufa wa Soya wokazinga
Wazani kamchere pang’ono kuchakudya chanu

section.title: Tizilombo toyambitsa matenda
content: Wazani nkhuku komanso khola mankhwala othana ndi nthata ngati Actellic kapena Akheri
Mwetsani  mankwala opha njoka za m'mimba pakatha masabata 18, kenako 21, kanako masabata 41 ndipo kenako miyezi 6 iliyonse.

section.title: Chipumphu cha misoti ndi khuku zazing'ono
content: Kafalidwe: kukhudzana ndi nkhuku yodwala kapena malo pomwe pali kachilombo koyambitsa matendawa. Mumpweya,fumbi, kuyenda ndi nkhuku zodwala kapena nyama ya nkhuku yodwala, zitosi ndi  ziwiya.
Kachilombo koyambitsa: Kosawoneka ndi maso kotchedwa Virus pa chizungu
Zizindikiro: Nkhuku zimakhumata, sizifuna kudya, , zimamwa madzi ambiri, zimakhazikika ndichipsyepsye, kutsekula mmimba zitosi za yelo, zimafa masiku ochepa.

Kupewa  kwake: Ukhondo wa zakudya ndi mkhola, kupopera 4% Fomalini nkhuku zikagulitsidwa pasabwere zina, perekani katemerawa Gumboro  tsiku la 10  ndi tsiku la 21 la moyo wake.osasakaniza nkhuku zazingono kapena zatsopano  ndi zazikulu za kale, osagula kapena kukawona nhkuku zodwala.
Kuchiza kwake: Palibe mankhwala.

section.title: Chitopa
content: Choyambitsa:Imayamba ndi kachilombo ka Vayilasi.

Zizindikiro: Nkhuku zimachepetsa papena kusiyilatu kuyikila, kuyenda motsimphina, kupindapinda khosi, kukanika kuyima kuyimilira, mmimba mwa zitosi zobiliwira, kufa zambiri, kutsokomola, madzi mmapapo, chakudya kusagwira bwino ntchito mthupi

Kupewa  kwake: Ukhondo wa zakudya ndi mkhola, kupopera 4% Fomalini nkhuku zikagulitsidwa pasabwere zina, perekani katemera wa Chitopa  tsiku la 16,tsiku la 28  kenako miyezi itatu iliyonse. osasakaniza nkhuku zazingono kapena zatsopano  ndi zazikulu za kale, osagula kapena kukawona nhkuku zodwala.

section.title: Matenda mmimba a nkhuku
content: Choyambitsa: Imayamba ndi kachilombo ka Pulotozowa
Zizindikiro: nkhuku zimawonda, kuchepa magazi, Blood in droppings, diarrhoea and ruffled feathers.
Kupewa: mKhola mukhale mowuma nthawi zonse, ikani mankhwala amatendawa mzakudya, nkhuku zisakhale zosiyana kakulidwe khola limodzi.
Kuchiza kwake: zimwetseni nkhuku mankhwala otchedwa Ampuloriyamu.

section.title: Chifuwa cha nkhuku
content: Choyambitsa: Imayamba ndi kachilombo kosawoneka ndi maso  kotchedwa Bakiteriya.
Zizindikiro:  Kutupa kumaso, kutuluka madzi  mmaso ndi mmphuno, Kutupa kunsi kuchigama,Kufwenthera ndikupuma movutikila, Kuwonda komaso kusafuna kudya.
Kupewa: Nkhuku zizibwera mkhola nthawi imodzi komaso zofanana ndikugulitsidwanso pamodzi.
Kuchiza kwake: Mwetsani mankhwala monga streptomycin.

section.title: Kolera wa Nkhuku
content: Choyambitsa: Imayamba ndi kachilombo kosawoneka ndi maso  kotchedwa Bakiteriya.

Zizindikiro: mwadzidzidzi; kufa kwa nkhuku zambilipo, Nkhuku zimapitilira kufabe, Kusasangalala, kusadya, kutluka zinthu mmaso ndi mphuno,  Kutupa kumaso, kutuluka madzi  mkamwa  ndi mmphuno, Kutupa kunsi kuchigama,Kufwenthera ndikupuma movutikila, Kuwonda komaso kusafuna kudya, bweya onyankhalala, mmimba ndi  kupuma mofulumira. Matenda okhalitsa; zilonda pa chinyopilo, kuchigama,molumikizizila ziwalo,mmapiko ndi  mmapazi zomwe zimatupa.Zilondanso  zimakhala mmimba ndi njira ya mpweya.
Kupewa: kutsatila njila zamakono zakawetedwe ka nkhuku. Nkhuku zisamakumane ndi anthu komso zinyama zina monga makoswe, nyama za mthengo ndi mbalame zomwe zimafalitsa matendawa.
Kuchiza kwake: Mwetsani mankhwala monga Triple Sulfer.

section.title: Nthomba za nkhuku
content: Choyambitsa: Imayamba ndi kachilombo kosawoneka ndi maso  kotchedwa virus.
Zizindikiro:  zimayamba ngati timatuza toyera timene timkhala tofiilira(brown)  pakapita nthawi ndipo masabata awiri pena atatu zimawuma.. Nkhuku siziyikila.
Kupewa: Temerani ndi poxine komso poperani mankhwala monga Actellic mkhola ndi nkhuku.
Kuchiza kwake: Palibe mankhwala koma dziwitsani alangizi.

section.title: Kasamalidwe ka nkhuku
content: Samalirani ndi kudyetsera bwino nkhuku zanu
Zipatseni katemera wa Lasota pa miyezi itatu iri yonse   kapena I - 2 pa miyezi inayi iriyonse  kuti muteteze nkhuku kumatenda a chitopa.
Musapereke katemera kunkhuku zomwe zikudwala kale chifuka sizichira.
Zimwetseni mankhwala wopha njoka za m’mimba makamaka miyezi yapakati pa Disembala ndi Malichi pamene mvula ikugwa kuti nkhuku zikule ndi thanzi.
Tethani kapena kwirirani nkhuku zonse zimene zafa ndi matenda kuopetsa kufala kwa matendawo.
Onetsetsani zizindikiro zili zonse za matenda ku nkhuku ndipo pitani kwa alangizi a ziweto kudera kwanu kuti akupatseni mankhwala oyenera

section.title: Misika ndi kagulitsidwe ka nkhuku
content: Nkhuku zalokolo zingathe kugulitsidwa ngati anapiye, pamene zafika poikira mzaira, ngakhalenso zitakula mokwanira
Nkhuku za lokolo zimagulitsidwa kwa mavenda ngakhale pali mwayi operekera makamaka mazira kumayiko ena ngati ku south africa ndi Burundi

section.title: Zinthu zomwe zimapangitsa kuti ulimi w nkhuku za Nyama upite patsogolo/upindule
content: Kuweta nkhuku zochepa kumabweretsa ndalama zochepa
Aalimi amene amasunga nkhuku zosachepera 500 amapanga phindu lochuluka kuyerekeza ndi alimi omwe amasunga nkhuku zochepera 500
Onetsetsani kuti nkhuku zanu ndizooneka mofanana pamene mwafika pogulitsa
Onetsetsani kuti nkhuku zanu ndizopatsa kaso komanso zovomerezeka pamsika kuti ulimi wanu upite chitsogolo
Onetsetsani kuti nkhuku zanu zili pa mpata okwanira
Onetsetsani kuti nkhuku zanu zakhala motakasuka kuti muchepetse kupanikizana kwa nkhuku zanu pamene mukusamalira mukhola mwanu

section.title: Komwe alimi angagule nkhuku zanyama
content: Gulani anapiye ongobadwa kumene pamene atha tsiku limodzi kapena nkhuku zomwe zafika poikira zomwe zatha masabata 18 kukula kwake ku Kampani ya Central Poultry ndi Proto Feeds mmashopu awo.

section.title: Zoyenera kutsatira pomanga makola a nkhuku za nyama
content: Alimi atsate njira zotsatirazi pomanga makola a nkhuku za nyama:
1. Sankhani malo otetezedwa ku mbava ndi nyama zoononga nkhuku
2.Mangani khola molingana ndi kuchuluka kwa nkhuku zanu, mwachitsanzo nkhuku 10 mpaka 15 zimafunika khola lotalika mamita awiri mbali zonse.
3. Folerani denga la khola ndi udzu kapena malata kuti mkhola muzikhala mouma nthawi zonse
4. Gwiritsani ntchito zipangizo zomangira khola zopezeka mosavuta monga mitengo, njerwa, bango, mchenga, udzu ndi mazenera
5. Pansi pa mkholamo yalanimo utuchi wa matabwa, udzu oduladula, kapenanso mankhusu a mphunga ochuluka mlingo wa 15cm kuchokera pansi kuti mkhola muzikhala mowuma.
6.Denga likhale lopitilirako khoma ndi 0.8m kapena 1m kuti mkhola musamalowe mphepo, mvula ya mpemera kapena dzuwa la mbiri
7. Khola likhalenso ndi mazenera okwanila kuti mudzilowa mpweya ndi kuwala kokwanila

section.title: Zofunikira m'nyumba ya chifundizi
content: Chifundizi chimayenera anapiye osapitilira masabata atatu akubadwa .Anapiye akhale mu chifundizi masabata osachepera awiri
Nyumba yosungira anapiye osapitilira masabata atatu iyenera kukhala yozungulira kuti anapiye asaunjikane pamodzi zimene zimapangitsa kufa potsatira kupondana.
Anapiye 100 amafunika malo okula 2000 sikweya sentimita komanso kutalika kwa mzere wapakati 2.0m
Anapiye 400 amafunika malo okula 8000 sikweya sentimita komanso kutalika kwa mzere wapakati 3.3m
Anapiye ayenera asungidwe mofundila koma osati motentha kwambiri.
Kutentha kwambiri kumasowetsa anapiye mtendere, kapena kuzizira kumapangitsa anapiye kuunjikana malo amodzi ndipo ena amafa komanso anapiye akazizidwa samamwa madzi okwanila ndipo sakula msanga

section.title: Mitundu ya chifundizi
content: kuika mbaula/babu pakati- nkhuku zimamva kutentha kuchokera pakati pomwe paikidwa mbaula/babu ndipo zimamva kuzizira zikakhala kutali ndi mbaulayi
Kuika mbaula/babu momwazikana- nkhuku zimamva kutentha kuchokera ku mbali zosiyanasiyana za chipindacho
Kuphatikiza mitundu iwiwi- mbaula imaikidwa pakati  ndi mmbali mwa chipinda chankhuku

Kutenthetsa mbali imodzi- njirayi imagwiritsa ntchito mbaula /babu mophatikiza ndi makatani a pulasitiki omwe amaikidwa ku mbali imodzi ya chipindacho. Nkhuku zimakhala mchipindachi kwa masiku pakati pa 10 kulekeza 21

section.title: Kutentha kapena kuzizira kwa mu chifundizi
content: Onetsetsani kuti kutentha kapena kuzizira kwa chipinda chosungiramo anapiye ndikoyenera potsatira khalidwe lomwe anapiye akuonetsa mchipindamo
Tingadziwe kuti mchipindamo mwatentha kwambiri ngati anapiye aunjikana mmakoma komanso akupuma mwakuya
Tingadziwe kuti mchipindamo mwauma ngati anapiye aunjikana pangodya za chipinda chathu ndipo ayang'ana mbali imodzi
Tingadziwe kuti mchipindamo mwazizira kwambiri ngati anapiye aunjikira mbaula kapena kukhala mounjikana pafupi ndi babu
Tingadziwe kuti mchipindamo muli bwino ngati anapiye amwazikana komanso akudya ndi kumwa mosavutikira

section.title: Zofunikira khola la nkuku zazikulu
content: Anapiye oyambira masabata anayi mpaka asanu ndi atatu ayenera kusungidwa mukhola laokha
Sungani anapiye okulirapo 10-12 pa sikweya imodzi

section.title: Kuweta anapiye mwapakamodzi
content: Anapiye omwe anatengedwa pakamodzi amawetedwa mchifundizi ndopo amasamutsiridwa ku khola la nkhuku zazikulu pakamodzi. Kenako alimi amapopera makhwala ochotsa matenda ndi tizilombo mchifundizi asanaikemo anapiye ena.
Kawetedweka kamathandiza kuchepetsa matenda ngakhale nthawi zambiri sizipindulitsa ngati nkhuku zowetedwazo zinali zochepa

section.title: Kuweta anapiye mopatsirana
content: Kuweta anapiye osiyana misinkhu ndipo amasamutsiridwa ku makola a nkhuku zazikulu motsogozana
Kawetedweka kamabweretsa mavuto a chitetezo ku nkhuku zathu
Ngakhale zili choncho, kawetedweka kamapereka phindu lochuluka chifukwa alimi amakhala akugulitsa nthawi zonse

section.title: Kukonzekera anapiye
content: Onetsetsani kuti ziwiya komanso khola ndi malo ozungulira ndizaukhondo. Poperani mankhwala oteteza ku tizilombo ndi matenda pasanadutse masabata awiri musanaikemo anapiye kuti muteteze matenda
Onetsetsani kuti mwakonzekera bwino lomwe pamene mukudikilira anapiye pokhala ndi zinthu zofunikira pa ulimiwu
Gulani ziwiya zoyenera potengera ndi kawetedwe ka nkhuku  komanso kuchuluka kwa anapiye.
Gulani zomwela madzi, zodyera, utuchi, mbaula, makala, chakudya (chakudya choyambilira cha nkhuku za nyama), madzi aukhondo, michere yofunikira, mankhwala, ndi muuni otchedwa halikeni

section.title: Ndondomeko pamene tikuyembekezera anapiye
content: Konzani chifundizi chanu maola 24 musanalandire anapiye
Ikani utuchi okwanira mozungulira chipinda choikamo anapiye
Tchingirani utuchi poika makatoni otchingira mmbali kuti nkhuku zisambweze kupitilira pomwe munalekezera kuika
Onetsetsani kuti utuci watsenderedwa bwino
Ikani zomwera madzi ndi zakudya
Ikani mbaula mchipindamu maola 12 anapiya asanaikidwemo kuti adzapeze mofundira

section.title: Kuika anapiye mu chifundizi
content: Onetsetsani kuti babu liyatsidwe usiku ndi usana kwa masiku atatu. Kuwala kumafunikira kwambiri kulekeza masiku khumi kuti anapiye adye kwambiri munthawiyi. Yatsani babu usiku kuti anapiye adzidyabe.
Onetsetsani kuti anapiye agulidwa kwa munthu mmodzi komanso akhale obadwa tsiku limodzi. Izi zimathandiza kuti pasakhale mpikisano pakai pa anapiyewa.
Tsiku loyamba lomwe anapiyewa afika, perekani madzi omwe asakanizidwa ndi michere yofunika kuti muchepetse kufa kwa anapiye chifukwa cha kuyenda mtunda wautali
Perekani chakudya choyambilira cha nkhuku zanyama
Onetsetsani kuti anapiye asanyowe kuti angazizidwe ndi kufa
Tikaika anapiye mchifundizi, tiwasiye kwa maola awiri tisanakawayendere kuti tione ngati akudya komanso kumwa madzi mokwanira komanso ngati adziwa pomwe paikidwa mbaula

section.title: Magulu a chakudya cha nkhuku za nyama
content: Nkhuku zanyama zimadya chakudya chomwe chimagawidwa mmagulu atatu. Chakudyachi chimachita kugulidwa ku makampani monga ProtoFeeds, CP Feeds, Ziweto, omwe amapanga chakudyachi poyika zonse zofunikira potengera msinkhu wa nkhuku
1. Chakudya cha anapiye osapitilira masiku 14
2. Chakudya chokulitsa cha nkhuku zoyambira masiku 15 kulekeza 42
3. Chakudya chomalizitsa cha nkhuku zamasiku pakati pa 43 ndi 56 za masabata 21 mpaka kupitilira.

section.title: Kuswanitsa/ Kuchulukitsa
content: Nkhumba zikhoza kukweretsedwa nthawi ina ili yonse ya pa chaka chofunika kwambiri ndi choti alimi azizindikira nkhumba yayikazi yomwe ikufuna mphongo pa nthawi yake

section.title: Kuzindikira nkhumba yayikazi yomwe ikufuna mphongo
content: nkhumba yayikazi yomwe ikufuna mphongo imaonetsa zizindikiro izi:
1. sikhazikika, imachoka chilakolako cha chakudya
2. kokodzera kumaoneka kotupa ndi kofiyira komanso kumatuluka chikazi choyera
3. nkhumbayo ikakanikizidwa pa msana pake imayima kukhala duu kuonetsa kubvomera kukweredwa

section.title: Mitundu ya zakudya za nkhumba
content: Nkhumba zimadya zakudya zosiyanasiyana
zina mwa izo ndi gaga, masamba
zotsala ku khitchini
zinthima ndi masamba a nthochi
masamba a gwafa ndi mango komanso chakudya chochita kusakaniza

section.title: Mitundu ya zakudya za nkhumba
content: Nkhumba zimafunika kudyetsera mukhola ndipo zidyetsedwe kosachepela katatu pa tsiku
Perekani madzi okwanira nthawi zonse

section.title: Mitundu ya zakudya za nkhumba
content: Tizilombo tapakhungu timanyerenyetsa ndi kuyamwa magazi mpaka nkhumba imatha magazi. tizilombotinso timafalitsa matenda monga zipere/mfundu/nkupe ndi chigodola.
Sambitsani nkhumba zanu ndi makhwala ophera tizilombo monga nkhupakupa ndi utitili kuti muchepeste kufala kwa tizilombo ta pakhungu ku ziweto zanu.
Tsukani mukhola ndi kuwazamo makhwala oteteza ndi kupha tizilombo monga nkhupakupa ndi utitili

section.title: Mitundu ya zakudya za nkhumba
content: Tizilombo ta mmimba timalimbana ndi chiweto pa zakudya mchifu komanso  timayamwa magazi mpaka nkhumbayo imanyentchera ndi kutha magazi
Mungateteze kufala kwa tizilombo ta m'mimba pomwetsa nkumba zanu ndi makhwala ophera njoka za mmimba miyezi itatu iliyonse.
Tsukani makola nthawi zonse pamene nkhumbazo za wonongera ndi ndowe zake kuthandiza kupewa kufala kwa njoka za mmimbazo .

section.title: Matenda a chigodola cha nkhumba
content: Zizindikiro za chigodola cha nkhumba:
1. Kufowoka
2. kuyenda dzandidzandi
3. kufiila kwa khungu
4. kutentha thupi
5. khungu limawoneka la ntundu wa buluwu
6. nkhumba zimafa patatha wola limodzi kapena tsiku limodzi
7. kutsekula mmimba ndi kupoloza

section.title: Kuteteza kufala ndi kupewa kwa chigodola cha nkhumba
content: 1. Nkhumba zikhale mukhola nthawi zonse,
2. khola likhale lozongulizidwa ndi mpanda
3. polowera mu khola pakhale makhwala opondapo polowa mukholamo
4. patulani nkhumba zimene zikudwala ndi kuziyika mukhola lazokha
5. musalole anzanu kapena alendo kulowa mukhola la nkhumba
6. kwirirani nkhumba zonse zimene zafa ndi chigondolachi
7. Dziwani kuti chigodola cha nkhumba chilibe mankhwala

section.title: Matenda amkupe kapena chipere
content: Zizindikilo za matenda a mkupe/chipere - Nkhumba zimadzikanditsa ku khoma la khola, ubweya umakudzuka,  kulimba kwa khungu ndiposo khumbazo zimakhala ndi tizilonda.
Matenda a mkupe/chipere amatetezedwa poonetsetsa kuti mukhola ndi mwaukhondo nthawi zonse. Onetsetsani kuti mukuchotsamo nkhumba zimene zadwala ndikuziyika mukhola mwazokha.
Kuti muchize matendawa, gwiritsani ntchito makhwala opaka pa chilonda ndipo funsani alangizi aziweto mudera lanu

section.title: Kagulitsidwe ka mbuzi za nyama
content: Limbikitsani alimi ankhumba kuti azikhala mmagulu. Ubwino wogulitsa nkhumba kudzera mmagulu ndiwoti alimi amakhala ndi mphamvu zambiri pamalondawa.
Pazikhala mgwilizano pakati Pa mlimi ndi ogula.

Pezani njira zina zopezera ndalama kusiyana ndikugulitsa nkhumba zanu motsika mtengo pamene mwakumana ndi vuto. Kotero khalani ndi njira zina zopezera ndalama monga kulima mbeu zosiyanasiyana komanso kuweta ziweto zosiyanasiyana

section.title: Mitundu ya chakudya cha ziweto
content: Pali magulu awiri a chakudya cha ziweto
1. Za mtundu wa nyemba: mtunduwu umakhala ndi zakudya zokulitsa kwambiri monga silver leaf, lukina ndi stylo.
2. Za Udzu: zimakhala ndi chakudya chambiri chonenepetsa monga rhodes grass, napier grass, ntchisi panicum, branciaria ndi guatemala

section.title: Nthawi yopanga zakudya zowonjezera
content: Kufutsa chakudya kumapangidwa kutengera ndi mtundu wa ka futsidwe ka chakudyacho.
Pofutsa chakudya cha ziweto kuchokera kuzotsalira za pokolola, tiyenera kufutsa tikangokolora
Ngati mukugwiritsa ntchito udzu, futsani pamene zangoyamba maluwa
Ngati mukugwiritsa ntchito za gulu la nyemba, futsani pamene zangoyamba maluwa kapena asanayambe kuthothola masamba

section.title: Kufutsa sayileji
content: Tchetchani udzu kapena chimanga chisanakhwime
Dulani ma pisi ang'onoang'ono
Tsenderani muzenje kapena mu thumba kuti muchotse mpweya
Vindikirani dzenje ndi pepala la pulasitic kapena mangani kwambiri kukamwa kwa thumbalo
Sungani pa malo pabwino

section.title: Kufutsa heyi
content: Chakudya chopangidwa kuchokera ku udzu chikololedwe pamene maluwa ayamba kuoneka
Pamene ngati tikugwiritsa ntchito mbewu za mtundu wa nyemba, muyenera kudula pamene masamba akungoyamba kumene kugwa, kapena pamene zikuyamba maluwa.
Pokonza chakudyachi, dulani udzu ndi sikilo m'mawa kusanachetsetse
Umikani udzu wanu moyenera. Poumika tembenuzani udzu wanu ukanyala. Onetsetsani kuti mwaumika bwino lomwe
Zikanyala,sanjani ndi kusunga pamalo pabwino

section.title: Kufutsa mapesi ndi masangwe
content: Gwiritsani ntchito mapesi a chimanga, mawere kapena mapira, zotsalira za mpunga ndiudzu ouma zomwe zimapezeka nthawi ya chilimwe.
Onetsestani kuti mwazimanga mmabandulo
Zisanjeni pa thandala pa mthunzi, potsatira ndondomeko yoyenera kuti chiswe chisaononge

Chakudya chiyenera kuphatikizidwa ndi  zina UREA kapena ma molasi chisanapatsidwe ku ziweto zanu motsatira ndondomeko kuopetsa kuchulutsa  UREA yemwe akachuluka angathe kukhala poizoni ku ziweto zathu.
